tools.description: Write on the ticket: a line of its history, and a notice to the requester, to the ones its stage waits for and, while it is with the requester, to the one who sent it back; nothing else of it changes. It says no revision of the ticket. The server may refuse a comment that comes too soon after one's last on the ticket (to be sent again later, with the same key), or one past the most comments a ticket holds

idempotency_key.description: The operation's key. A new operation takes a new key, and the same call sent again (after a network failure, or when no answer came back) takes the same key: the same key again answers what the first answered, and changes nothing. A submit or a resubmit made again with other values, or after a refusal, is a new operation, and takes a new key. Up to 255 bytes of visible ASCII (`!` to `~`, no space); another key is answered 400

comment.description: What the person writes: up to 2,000 characters. One left out, null, empty or longer is the machine's to refuse (409, `comment`), as the entry reads it

tools.name: get_organization
tools.title: The organization
tools.description: The version of the organization in effect today: its teams, people and members. Answered 404: No version of the organization is in effect today, or the person is not one of the people of the version in effect: the organization holds everyone's addresses, and is read by its people alone

tools.name: find_people
tools.title: Find people
tools.description: The people of the version of the organization in effect today, found by words, the closest first: the ones whose ID (a row's key) or name, in either language, holds every word of `q`, the words and the values compared in NFKC, without white space, the hiragana as katakana and in lower case; no words find every one. The ID or key and the name alone are answered, at most `limit` of them, and `more` says whether more are found. The vectors `organization/find.jsonl` say each step of the comparison and of the order. Answered 404: No version of the organization is in effect today, or the person is not one of the people of the version in effect: the organization holds everyone's addresses, and is read by its people alone

q.description: The words to find by, apart with white space: up to 200 characters. None find every one

limit.description: The most it answers; 20 when it is left out

lang.description: The language of the names; the server's when it is left out
